subject: Your brain's plumbing runs on a 24-hour clock: new study links wakefulness and CSF oscillations
script: From Agewell Brief: Your brain's plumbing runs on a 24-hour clock: new study links wakefulness and CSF oscillations. A 34-hour sleep deprivation study reveals that cerebrospinal fluid oscillations—the brain's clearance waves—rise with time awake and peak in the early morning, driven by wake-promoting nuclei, not norepinephrine. Your brain is a hydraulic organ. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
